title: 3dPFM
description: Program for identifying brief BOLD events in fMRI time series using Paradigm Free Mapping

input.description: Specify the dataset to analyze (e.g., epi.nii).
input.title: Input dataset

mask.description: Process voxels inside this mask only. Default is no masking.
mask.title: Mask dataset

algorithm.description: Regularization function used for HRF deconvolution (dantzig or lasso).
algorithm.title: Deconvolution Algorithm

criteria.description: Model selection criterion for HRF deconvolution (BIC or AIC).
criteria.title: Model Selection Criteria

nonzeros.description: Choose estimate with a fixed number of nonzero coefficients.
nonzeros.title: Non-zero coefficients

maxiter.description: Maximum number of iterations in the homotopy procedure (absolute value).
maxiter.title: Maximum Iterations

maxiterfactor.description: Maximum number of iterations relative to the number of volumes.
maxiterfactor.title: Maximum Iterations Factor

tr.description: Repetition time or sampling period of the input data.
tr.title: Repetition Time (TR)

hrf.description: Haemodynamic response function used for deconvolution.
hrf.title: HRF Model

idx_hrf.description: 3D dataset with voxel-dependent indexes for HRF.
idx_hrf.title: HRF Index Dataset

LHS.description: Additional regressors to be fitted to the dataset.
LHS.title: Additional Regressors

jobs.description: Number of parallel jobs to use in processing.
jobs.title: Parallel Jobs

nSeg.description: Divide into segments to report progress.
nSeg.title: Segmentation for Progress Reporting

verb.description: Verbosity level (0 for quiet, 1 for talkative).
verb.title: Verbosity Level
